_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Tha thu a' cluich Golf (Geama Chàrtean) - Cluichiche {player_id}.
Amas: Faigh an ìre as ìsle de scòr san turas aonarach seo. Ma tha colbhan a' dol a dh'fhàs an aon luach, tha iad air an cur ri chèile mar 0.
Luachan Càrtean: A=1, 2-10=luach aghaidh, J/Q=10, K=0

Gnìomhan (cleachd bràistean tèarainte):
- '[draw]' - Tarraing bho chluasag
- '[take]' - Gabh bho chuibhle dh'fhàgail
- '[swap X Y]' - Fàs càrtean tarraingte le àite X (sreath) Y (colbh)
- '[discard]' - Fàg càrtean tarraingte

board.drew:
Thog thu: {card}
A-nis feumaidh thu [swap X Y] no [discard] e
board.took:
Thog thu: {card} bho chuibhle dh'fhàgail
Feumaidh thu [swap X Y] leis (chan urrainn dhut fhàgail)

options.final_turns: Turasan deireannach! Do roghainnean: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Feumaidh tu: [swap X Y] (chan urrainn dhut cairtean a thilgeil bhon stac tilleadh)

message.deck_empty: Tha an deic falamh! Bidh a' gheama a' crìochnachadh sa bhad.
message.knocked: Player {pid} air a bhualadh! Tha gach cluicheadair eile aig aon chuairt.
message.final_round: Cluichiche {pid} {reason}! Gheibh a h-uile cluichiche eile aon tuilleadh turas

reason.all_revealed: Tha a h-uile cairt air nochdadh.

invalid.wrong_action: Cleachd aon ghnothach bràiste: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], no [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Feumaidh thu a' chiad [draw], [take], [knock], no [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Chan urrainn dhut cairt a thoirt às an stac-cairteachaidh, feumaidh tu atharrachadh.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Tha càrtean tarraing thu. Feumaidh thu [swap X Y] no [discard] e
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Feumaidh tu cairt air a tharraing gus iomlaid.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Feumaidh tu cairt air a tharraing gus an tilgeil thu.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Àite a-muigh crìochan. Cleachd sreath 1-{max_row}, colbh 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Chan urrainn dhut a bhith ag èirigh le cairt air an tarraing. Cuir crìoch air do thionndadh mu thràth.
invalid.already_knocked: Tha cuideigin air a' chuairt seo a bhualadh mar-thà.
invalid.already_revealed: Tha an cairt sin air a nochdadh mu thràth!
